# g10 – Constrained optimization problem

## Definition
- **Objective**: Minimize f(x)
- **Variables**: n = 8
- **Domain**: 100 ≤ x_1 ≤ 10000, 1000 ≤ x_i ≤ 10000 for i = 2, 3, 10 ≤ x_i ≤ 1000 for i = 4, ..., 8

## Mathematical Formulation

### Objective Function
```math
f(x) = x_1 + x_2 + x_3
```

### Constraints
```math
g_1(x) = -1 + 0.0025 (x_4 + x_6) \leq 0
```
```math
g_2(x) = -1 + 0.0025 (x_5 + x_7 - x_4) \leq 0
```
```math
g_3(x) = -1 + 0.01 (x_8 - x_5) \leq 0
```
```math
g_4(x) = -x_1 x_6 + 833.33252 x_4 + 100 x_1 - 83333.333 \leq 0
```
```math
g_5(x) = -x_2 x_7 + 1250 x_5 + x_2 x_4 - 1250 x_4 \leq 0
```
```math
g_6(x) = -x_3 x_8 + 1250000 + x_3 x_5 - 2500 x_5 \leq 0
```

## Best Known Value
f(x*) = 7049.331
